MOD INFORMATION
Modified Sounds: Default Azir

Author: Hungry Weasel

Mod version: 1.0

Description: Azir running his yap again. This pack replaces ALL Azir voice lines with custom ones that mimic his in-game English voice using a voice model.


FEATURES
Supports the following languages: En_us

Modifies all Azir voice lines excluding his laugh and certain yelling


ABOUT THE MOD
This voice-pack was created with RVC using a custom-made Azir voice model. All voice lines were recorded and fed through the model to mimic Azir’s in-game English voice.
